description: Search every public KYMA369 FAQ answer (https://kyma369.com/faq). Use before answering PEMF, Rife, Lakhovsky, Solfeggio, or product questions. Returns the question, a short answer, and the canonical URL. Omit query to list the highest-scored FAQs. Use offset to page through the full bank.

offset.description: Skip this many matches to page through the full FAQ bank

query.description: Question words. Empty lists the top public FAQs.

name: search_faq
